ai_summary: The fellowships support independent research and education in astronomy or astrophysics for recent doctoral scientists. Eligible applicants include U.S. citizens, nationals, or lawful permanent residents who have earned their doctoral degree within the last five years.
ai_quote: NSF Astronomy and Astrophysics Postdoctoral Fellowships provide an opportunity for highly qualified, recent doctoral scientists to carry out an integrated program of independent research and education.
